title: Unit Event — With Our Wounded Hands — Episode2 Entrusting a Wish

meta.Event Outline: Ena hasn't been able to reach Mizuki since the school festival. She doesn't know what the right thing to do is, but her regrets compel her to seek Mizuki out for a heart-to-heart.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki... What are you doing right now?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wonder if you're keeping in contact with someone else...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If Mizuki quits being a member of N25 and stops showing up in SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (We might never see each other again.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm worried sick about you, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I was hoping that Mizuki would be here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Have you seen Mizuki at all...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I caught a glimpse of Mizuki's face a couple of times when I went over to see what was going on...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I keep ending up somewhere pitch black. I think that phone's been put away in a drawer somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did you know this was gonna happen?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: At the very least, I know that this isn't what Mizuki wanted.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: To be with us like always.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We'd have pointless conversations, smile, laugh and just have fun together...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
After hearing the truth, I choked up...
I didn't know what I should say.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What if I was more mentally prepared?
What if Mizuki was the one who told me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't think that would've made a difference.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That time, if I just replied, “I didn't know that,” or, “Thanks for telling me.”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, what happens when we try going back to our normal lives? We could talk online as N25 and go out shopping together...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But a part of me would always be wondering...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Can I ask? Should I ask? Would bringing it up hurt Mizuki in any way?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wouldn't be able to get it out of my mind...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which would be the worst thing for Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, MEIKO, I have a question to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What if I asked for us to meet and talk once more?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What if I said that I still want us to be friends?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is me just thinking that only going to hurt Mizuki even more...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you want to talk, you should talk.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want you to say what's on your mind.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm also in the dark here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No one knows the answer to this question. Actually, you probably won't find it anywhere...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, the person you're talking about is in a fragile state. One wrong move could cause an irreparable break.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In truth, I don't want anyone to take that risk.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If we just let things proceed as is, then that's it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That is why your feelings may be the last bastion of hope for Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is it okay for me to...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You should just do what you feel the need to do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, I'm going to meet with Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We're going to meet and I'm going to say what's on my mind...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm going to say that I want us to keep being friends.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, MEIKO, please let me know if you hear any news.
